2) Mr. Umesh G. Revankar was re-appointed as Managing Director and CEO of the Company at the 40th Annual General Meeting (AGM) held on June 27, 2019 for a period of 5 (five) years with effect from October 26, 2019 up to October 25, 2024. 5) Mr. Sunder Subramanian was appointed as Whole Time Director of the Company for a period of 5 (five) years commencing from October 31, 2025 to October 30, 2030 and designated as Joint Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer with effect from December 05, 2025 vide Ordinary Resolution passed through Postal ballot by the Shareholders of the Company on December 02, 2025.
